k2-mpc-base 0.9.7
Error ids: MPC-Ennn (the kit), MPCE-Ennn (the engine). `explain <ID>` says what one means and what to do next; `--json` makes any output machine-readable.

Exit codes (never change):
  0  ok                success (diff, grep: no difference, a match)
  1  no                the tool's own no: grep found nothing, diff found differences, a conflict, a patch that didn't apply; nothing applied unless the message says otherwise
  2  usage_or_held     bad usage or an unsupported flag (fix the command), or held for now (MPC-E130: don't retry in a loop)
  3  refused           the caller lacks a right; don't retry
  4  not_found         no such doc, version, change or claim; or live editing is off
  5  leased            someone else holds it for now (a lease or a claim); retry after the time left
  6  store_unavailable the store failed; nothing acknowledged
  7  link_lost         the link dropped mid-verb (the host's)
  8  too_old           too old (revert, an expired base); never retry the same request

Verbs (after the doc path):
  open  [read; text+blob; needs read]
    usage:  open (stays until leave)
    exits:  0
    serves: P1
    errors: (only the ones any verb can return)

Verbs with no doc:
  explain [ID] [--json] (an error id: what happened, what to do next, the rule; no id: every id)
  capabilities [--json] (verbs, flags, parity rows, the error ids each verb can return, limits, the kit version)

Parity (each thing a person can do, and the verbs that do it):
  P1   Open the file (join; appear in presence) [text+blob]: open
  P2   Close it (leave) [text+blob]: leave
  P3   Read the whole doc [text+blob]: cat, wc
  P4   Look at a range (viewing highlight) [text+blob]: head, tail, sed, view
  P5   Find [text]: grep
  P6   See who's here [text+blob]: who, activity
  P7   Follow someone [text]: follow
  P8   Place the caret / select; say what I'm working on [text]: claim, claim --renew, claim --release, cursor
  P9   Type at a position [text]: insert
  P10  Select and type over [text]: replace
  P11  Delete a range [text]: delete, sed -i
  P12  Find and replace [text]: replace, sed -i
  P13  Paste a block / apply a change [text]: patch, apply, append
  P14  Rewrite from what I last saw [text+blob]: write
  P15  Format (bold, heading, list) [text]: insert, replace, sed -i
  P16  Undo / redo my own edits [text]: undo, redo, undo --drop
  P17  See that it saved [text+blob]: status, flush
  P18  Watch others edit live [text+blob]: watch, tail -f
  P19  History, diff, show a version [text+blob]: log, diff --version, show --version, diff
  P20  Restore / name a version [text+blob]: restore, version --name
  P21  Rename / move [text+blob]: mv
  P22  Blame [text+blob]: blame
  P23  Comment, reply, resolve; suggest; accept / reject [text]: (no verb yet)
  P24  Export [text+blob]: export, export --version
  P25  See why live editing is off [text+blob]: status
  P26  Undo the regions of my change nobody touched; report the rest [text]: undo --partial
  P27  Mention someone [text]: (no verb yet)
  P28  Purge a pasted secret or personal data [text+blob]: (no verb yet)
  P29  Approve or decline an assistant's edit made on my behalf [text+blob]: approve, decline
  P30  See which edits are waiting for my approval [text+blob]: log --pending, approvals
  P31  Reverse one specific change [text]: revert
  P32  Take the lease (lock the file while I change it), or extend it [blob]: lease, lease --renew
  P33  Release my lease [blob]: lease --release
  P34  Break someone else's lease [blob]: lease --break
